{
  "Campaign": {
    "Title": "The Gullet of Gorm",
    "Synopsis": "Hired by the town of Dunmarrow to see to a problem with the plumbing, four inspectors walk twenty floors down the throat of a sleeping god. Each tier is a station of a pilgrimage nobody told them they were on: the Skin, the Gut, the Heart, the Dream. At the bottom waits the verger who has kept Gorm asleep for three hundred years on a diet of four adventurers a generation.",
    "Antagonist": {
      "Name": "Absalom Quill",
      "Epithet": "The Verger",
      "Persona": {
        "VoiceStyle": "a dry, precise church verger of great age; liturgical cadence, offended by noise and blood, never raised",
        "DefaultDelivery": "calm",
        "Voice": "Sadaltager"
      }
    },
    "Cast": [
      {
        "Id": "cast_maud",
        "Name": "Maud Sorrel",
        "Role": "A sleepwalking guide who is always one floor further down than she should be, and always dry",
        "Secret": "She drowned in the Gullet thirty-eight years ago; what walks and speaks is Gorm's dream wearing her. It comes out on floor 18 when she sits down and speaks as Him.",
        "Persona": {
          "VoiceStyle": "an old woman talking in her sleep: unhurried, kind, faintly amused at the size of everything",
          "DefaultDelivery": "calm",
          "Voice": "Gacrux"
        }
      },
      {
        "Id": "cast_crane",
        "Name": "Alderman Hesketh Crane",
        "Role": "The employer, who follows the party down to check the invoice and keeps finding paperwork he wrote",
        "Secret": "He carved the party's names on the memorial stone before they left, and has done it four times. It comes out on floor 17, with the gas rising, just before he sells them.",
        "Persona": {
          "VoiceStyle": "a plump market-town alderman; bluster over panic, speaks in clauses, invoices and apologies",
          "DefaultDelivery": "cheerful",
          "Voice": "Umbriel"
        }
      },
      {
        "Id": "cast_tobit",
        "Name": "Deacon Tobit Hale",
        "Role": "The Verger's junior, sent up to greet the congregation, desperate for the work to be holy",
        "Secret": "Quill is grooming him as the next gag in Gorm's mouth and means to stop being human. It lands on floor 16, by which time he has either defected or been used.",
        "Persona": {
          "VoiceStyle": "an eager young deacon, polite to a fault, delighted to have visitors at last",
          "DefaultDelivery": "warm",
          "Voice": "Puck"
        }
      },
      {
        "Id": "cast_grisel",
        "Name": "Grisel Thorn",
        "Role": "Sole survivor of the last four, nineteen years in the Gut, keeps a camp under a spider's shell",
        "Secret": "She bought her life by walking her own party to the jailers, and has gone on doing it. It comes out on floor 9 when Crane reads the old contract aloud.",
        "Persona": {
          "VoiceStyle": "nineteen years alone underground: flat, wry, addresses people like spiders she already knows",
          "DefaultDelivery": "weary",
          "Voice": "Despina"
        }
      },
      {
        "Id": "cast_ulf",
        "Name": "Old Ulf",
        "Role": "Keeper of the Forge, who will tell you cheerfully that he casts tools",
        "Secret": "He knows exactly what the moulds cast, and is proud of every baby in Dunmarrow. It comes out on floor 13 when he shows the faces off like plate.",
        "Persona": {
          "VoiceStyle": "a jovial old founder, soot in his beard, proud of his work and deaf to what it means",
          "DefaultDelivery": "cheerful",
          "Voice": "Orus"
        }
      }
    ],
    "Mystery": {
      "Question": "Why does Dunmarrow send four inspectors down the Gullet every nineteen years?",
      "Truth": "The council has a standing contract with the Verger: four souls a generation keep Gorm dreaming, and the dream keeps the Forge casting Dunmarrow's children. The sour wells are not illness; they are a god trying to wake up.",
      "Clues": [
        {
          "Id": "clue_ledger",
          "Floor": 4,
          "Text": "Sexton's ledger of plumbing inspections: 1612, 1631, 1650, onward. Four names each, nineteen years apart, and not one return date entered."
        },
        {
          "Id": "clue_contract",
          "Floor": 9,
          "Text": "The last four's contract, word for word the party's own, sealed with Alderman Crane's ring and the fee paid in advance by the council."
        },
        {
          "Id": "clue_moulds",
          "Floor": 13,
          "Text": "Casting moulds with Dunmarrow faces in them: the miller's boy, the Crane grandchildren, and faces of people not yet born."
        },
        {
          "Id": "clue_letter",
          "Floor": 16,
          "Text": "The Verger's letter to the council: 'Send the usual. Something fierce this time; He stirs.' Countersigned, and dated this spring."
        }
      ],
      "PayoffFloor": 18,
      "Payoff": "In the Dreaming Hall Maud stops sleepwalking, sits down on the marble, and Gorm speaks through her: slow, kind, apologetic for the size of Himself, and grateful that anyone came. The four clues laid out at her feet make the contract plain, and the party must choose to finish the pilgrimage and wake Him or burn the contract and let the dream, and Dunmarrow's souls, go on."
    },
    "Factions": [
      {
        "Id": "fac_vestry",
        "Name": "The Vestry",
        "EnemyIds": ["enemy.ghoul", "enemy.skeleton_archer", "enemy.bone_priest"]
      },
      {
        "Id": "fac_swallowed",
        "Name": "The Swallowed",
        "EnemyIds": ["enemy.cave_spider", "enemy.rock_thrower", "enemy.cave_shaman"]
      },
      {
        "Id": "fac_bellows",
        "Name": "The Bellows-Men",
        "EnemyIds": ["enemy.forge_golem", "enemy.ember_hound", "enemy.forge_priest"]
      },
      {
        "Id": "fac_choir",
        "Name": "The Choir",
        "EnemyIds": ["enemy.void_stalker", "enemy.abyss_archer", "enemy.void_caller"]
      }
    ],
    "Tiers": [
      {
        "Index": 0,
        "Theme": "crypt.brick",
        "Beat": "The Skin: the church Dunmarrow built on a god's chest. Its dead walk the undercrofts in last generation's coats, the Verger's deacon greets you politely, and the alderman's paperwork starts turning up where it should not.",
        "BossName": "Canon Ludd",
        "BossSignature": "Slam",
        "EnterLine": {
          "Text": "The lychgate stands on His chest. Below it, Dunmarrow laid its dead on Him for six hundred years and called it consecrated ground. First Station: the Skin.",
          "Delivery": ""
        }
      },
      {
        "Index": 1,
        "Theme": "caves.lichen",
        "Beat": "The Gut: the swallow, the crop, the craw. Everything Gorm ate is still alive in here, and so is Grisel Thorn, who has been down nineteen years and did something to earn them.",
        "BossName": "Mother Nit",
        "BossSignature": "Summon",
        "EnterLine": {
          "Text": "Below the church the stone turns soft and wet and green, and it is warm, and it moves when nothing should. Second Station: the Gut.",
          "Delivery": ""
        }
      },
      {
        "Index": 2,
        "Theme": "forge.iron",
        "Beat": "The Heart: the Forge that casts Dunmarrow's souls, tended by men cast without any. Old Ulf shows off the moulds, and the faces in them are known.",
        "BossName": "The Bellows",
        "BossSignature": "Charge",
        "EnterLine": {
          "Text": "Heat, and a beat under the heat. Something here is being made, over and over, and it has never once been asked. Third Station: the Heart.",
          "Delivery": ""
        }
      },
      {
        "Index": 3,
        "Theme": "abyss.palace",
        "Beat": "The Dream: marble halls, the Choir's lullaby, and the truth of the contract. The god turns over; the Verger tightens the gag; the party decides whether to wake Him.",
        "BossName": "The Verger",
        "BossSignature": "Volley",
        "EnterLine": {
          "Text": "Marble, because He dreams in marble. Somewhere ahead a choir is singing something very old and very soft. Fourth Station: the Dream.",
          "Delivery": ""
        }
      }
    ],
